en: The forging process behind this sword is passed down in the masked tribe. All members forge their own swords when they begin working as mercenaries. Its blade is made from a special metal that responds to the forger's magical energy, thus preventing anyone else from equipping it. In return, it provides incredible ease of use. It boasts an excellent balance between offensive and defensive ability, and is perfect for solo combat.

This sword has been forged entirely from an ultra-hard, lightweight metal known as Levissium. Although Levissium is well known among blacksmiths, it is difficult to process using current technology, and few other people know of it. The focus of this sword's forger was clearly on usability, and although it is somewhat lacking in terms of attack power, it makes up for this in defensive ability. Its lightness means that the user can move more swiftly and dodge sudden attacks.

A sword made using a time-elemental spritnite stone. Long ago, a magician carrying out forbidden research succeeded in sealing time energy inside a physical object, and this taboo blade is a result of transferring that energy into a weapon. Everything its blade slices through turns a frosty white before crumbling into nothingness, and this is the reason behind its name. Foes hit with this blade receive time-elemental damage.

A thin sword that glows with a golden hue. It was forged from a magnetized metal that was repeatedly refined using powerful magical energy in order to further increase its density. The effect of the magnetism and magical energy have given it a curved and jutted blade. Although thin, its blade is incredibly strong and supple, and the powerful magical energy imbued in it means it does not nick easily. The special metal and magical energy used when forging it cause it to inflict light-elemental damage.

This curved sword is wrapped in blazing flames. It was created using a spritnite stone containing fire energy with a particular affinity to metal. In order to best extract this energy, the blade has been tempered using Teruru ore that has accumulated natural magical energy over many years. It is very easy to wield, and produces powerful slashes without much force being exerted. The brightly burning crimson gem set in its guard and the fire energy sealed inside it inflict powerful fire-elemental damage.

A sword thought to have been created by an organization that once carried out research into magical energy. Its dull red blade leaves little to be desired in terms of attack power, but also contains an enormous amount of magical energy, which can be further increased through tempering. It was created based around the concept of "a demon to slay demons." Few weapons created by the organization that made it remain, and its rarity and historical value make it a highly-sought-after item among collectors.

This sword is wrapped in a freezing aura of ice. It was forged using an extremely laborious and time-consuming process. The water-elemental spritnite stone used is said to have a bad affinity with metal, but it is also able to permeate other substances, so it was made to gradually permeate the metal over a long period of time. Its whole blade is cloaked in elemental magical energy, and the energy emanating from its guard also further increases the water-elemental damage inflicted.

A sword forged using techniques that originate from an ancient land, where it was known as a "wazamono." Unlike heavier blades that employ great force when striking at foes, its light and simple blade relies on a fearsome sharpness, and is able to easily slice through even bone. Its edge is completely smooth, to the point where it can be considered a work of art. Its fine blade can cut through anything, and will produce even greater attack power when sharpened.

A sword created from ancient relics excavated from the ruins of the ancient kingdom that once ruled over the mainland. When analyzed, these relics were found to contain vast magical energy. The sword's blade was forged using a process that cannot be replicated today, and combined with this great magical energy, it gives the weapon truly mighty power. However, the weapon's true value lies in the increased damage inflicted when striking a foe's weak element.

A sword created entirely from materialized magical energy.
Momentum power was used when materializing it, and the blade can still control this power. It is able to cut through the flow of time itself, a feat thought to be impossible. The weapon's true worth lies in the honing effect it has on the user's senses, which boosts the rate at which the SP gauge rises, allowing the user to strike at gaps in foes' defenses with perfect precision.

A giant, sinister blade crafted using various monster bones and metals. It was wielded by one of the three rare-blood sisters. Their sadness, rage, and suffering can be felt through the blade, and these negative emotions eat away at the wielder's heart. However, when the wielder understands the reasons for the sisters' pain, a vague kindness and sense of relief can also be sensed.
Its blade is soaked with the blood of countless battles and the negative emotions of those it has slain, and it is steeped in shadow-elemental energy.

A mysterious sword created in an alternate dimension. Its jet-black blade belies an unbelievable lightness, and it fits the hand with a strange sense of familiarity, feeling like an extension of the user's own body. Its guard is shaped like two crossed swords, which are likely some sort of crest or symbol. When held in the hand, the sword imbues a strangely calm feeling, filling the user with bravery and benevolence. It possesses exceptional physical attack power, and is even said to bring good luck.

A sword that glows with all the colors of the rainbow. The "rainbow ore" appears in countless legends, but no one has ever seen it, and its very existence has been called into question. However, this sword has without a doubt been forged from this very ore. No legends tell of who made the sword, or where, but in the tales it appears in it is carried by kings and heroes. Blows delivered by its rainbow-colored blade strike foes' vital organs with utmost precision, delivering huge damage.

A sword forged in ancient times. Pengies were once thought to be messengers from a faraway realm, and were worshipped by humans. This sword was made for a royal to take to the afterlife, and the face of a Pengy can be seen on all four sides of its guard. Its pommel is also fitted with a spritnite stone that guards against disaster. The blessings imbued upon the sword and the effect of the stone protect the user against elemental attacks. Its design is simple, but it is a very rare item, and also has a high cultural value.

Chakrams such as this are worn by the sacrifices when they depart on their pilgrimages, and they have been used both as protective talismans and defensive weapons since long ago. It has a simple, round shape, which makes it very easy to use. It contains a large amount of magical energy, resulting from the special ore used to create it and the various rites and prayers that have been cast upon it. It is generally used as a throwing weapon, inflicting damage on multiple enemies in a straight line from the user.

This chakram is modeled after a "shuriken," a legendary weapon from an ancient land. It is more attack-oriented than a regular chakram. The thin blades protruding from it boast an incredible sharpness, and its attack power can be further increased by tempering them. However, as it was created using an ore that primarily provides physical attack power, it contains little magical energy, and in comparison to other weapons is somewhat lacking in terms of magical attack power.

An unusually shaped chakram with a bumpy edge. It was created by a craftsman as a decorative piece, modeled after the shape of the hem of a long dress, but has been reappropriated as a weapon because of the high defense and evasion capabilities that it offers. The bumps on the edge of its blade and the piece that protects the bearer's hand mean that it provides excellent defense power against simple physical attacks. It is also able to deftly ward off attacks, making it easy to evade enemy attacks completely.

A pretty-looking chakram shaped like a crescent moon.
It was made by a master craftsman using large amounts of a meteorite shard containing immense magical energy. The weapon's cute appearance belies powerful magical energy, which its maker was able to imbue in it by using a man-made ore to fully extract the shard's energy. However, the weapon's magical energy can still be further increased by tempering.

A chakram in the shape of a star. It was created by the daughter of a master craftsman, using a meteorite shard containing vast energy, and as a result is imbued with far greater magical energy than a regular chakram. As well as delivering increased magical damage when attacking, it is also very effective at defending against magical attacks.

A chakram in the shape of a clock. It was created from an ore recently discovered in the mountains that possesses the mysterious ability to absorb magical energy from its surroundings. The chakram's clock-like shape is designed to control the flow of magical energy within it. The powerful energy contained in the ore used to create it activates the clock hand, boosting the flow of magical energy and speeding up the rate at which the bearer's ATB gauge fills up.

This chakram is adorned with a ribbon tied in a bow. It seems to be quite old, and its blade is well-used but has been carefully maintained, indicating that it was used regularly by someone over a long period. What is most surprising is that the large yellow ribbon adorning it is said to have been worn by a sacrifice in ancient times, and to possess the power to ward off disaster. This ribbon's weaving process has long since been forgotten.

Two horn-like spikes protrude from the blade of this chakram. Its subdued color, simple design, and sleek curves give it a captivating and somehow elegant appearance. It has been created using a special spritnite stone, and allows the bearer to sense the presence of nearby beings and act preemptively. After all, a true lady is never caught unprepared...

A chakram created using a special ore that reacts to magical energy. Its pale orange hue, reminiscent of a sunset, indicates its great magical energy, and the metal used to forge it causes this color to become more vivid when reacting to magical energy, shining like a halo above the head of the bearer. Not only is it beautiful in form, it grants both high magical attack power and high physical and magical defense power.

This chakram glows with a silver hue. Fashioned after the wings of an angel, its structure is delicate and almost sculpture-like, and the large wings protruding from it give the bearer an angelic appearance. It is imbued with the prayers of many holy people, and possesses a sacred power. When attacking enemies it recovers the user's own magical energy.

A cute chakram modeled after a Pengy. A craftsman made this one-of-a-kind item as a joke, but it in fact makes a more-than-adequate weapon. When worn on the head, it gives the wearer a Pengy-like appearance. For some reason, this seems to make the wearer less likely to be attacked by monsters, suggesting that even they possess some sense of camaraderie. A fine piece, and its maker deserves great praise for a piece that was in fact only created in jest.

This weapon could easily be mistaken for an actual bow and arrow, but is most certainly a chakram. The bow part and arrow part have each been forged from separate materials, both of which are extremely rare. The bow is made from a shard of the moon, and grants high physical attack power, while the arrow is made from a fragment of the sun, and grants high magical attack power. Together, these two materials both give an attack power much greater than they each would grant separately.

A chakram shaped like a snowflake. It is incredibly thin, but is protected by powerful magical energy that prevents it from ever breaking. The central plate channels energy into the six plates around it, and these plates also conduct external energy and channel it into the central plate. The additional magical energy that it grants to the user increases the range of healing techs. The way the parts that make up this chakram are interrelated is like a metaphor for the sacrifice and her guard.

A small, simple dagger. Although it may appear to be no more than a regular dagger, it has in fact been crafted using a rare ore not found in this land, and boasts a sturdy blade with a keen edge. It also possesses a high amount of magical energy, and performs well both as a catalyst for magical attacks and in terms of magical defense. Its only weak point to speak of is its slightly low physical power, but it nevertheless makes an excellent all-round weapon.

A unique dagger, easily recognizable by its flame-shaped blade. It has been forged using a combination of two ores: one from a lightstone that fell from the sky, and one from a shadowstone born in darkness. When combining these two ores, the two opposing elements mean that forging a straight blade is extremely difficult. Even when forged correctly, the result is a curved blade as seen in this weapon. It is imbued with the time element.

A dagger that includes a gauntlet. Designed with defense in mind, it allows the user to evade attacks more effectively than a regular dagger. Even when attacks are received, its design means that the chances of a fatal wound being inflicted are slim, and it is able to reduce damage from both physical and magical attacks. However, the addition of the gauntlet makes the weapon slightly cumbersome, inhibiting speed, and its attack power is also a little low.

A beautiful, perfectly clear dagger. It was created using a transparent icestone that can only be found in a perilous mountain region. Not only is it beautiful in form, it also boasts excellent physical attack power, and a blade so keen that wounds it inflicts are incredibly hard to close. The forging process behind it is so complex that no other weapon of its kind exists, and coupled with its great beauty this makes it highly sought after as a collector's item as well as for combat purposes.

A dagger created using Jael ore, the toughest material to be found anywhere on the mainland. Its forger's only purpose was to create a blade with the greatest possible sharpness, and it does indeed boast an incredibly keen edge. Jael is a particularly difficult ore to process, but recent advances in magic technology have made its use possible. However, the technology used is still developing, and requires considerable skill and magical energy, not to mention funds, meaning the ore's use is still extremely rare.

A knife that was once used in ancient rituals. Although their effectiveness is questionable, rituals to suppress the wrath of the monsters were carried out in various places across the land, and this weapon is one example of the ceremonial items that were used. Its hilt is covered in tiny runes, and as well as softening magical attacks, these serve to increase the user's magical energy.

A jet-black dagger that emits a bewitching dull hue. It was crafted using an ore possessing immense magical energy that fell down from a body of stars known as the "Black Cross." If the whole blade of the weapon is polished, magical energy will flow out from all angles, so it is important to only polish its very edge, controlling this energy and assuring optimal release during combat. Its blade has also been set with a spritnite stone known as the "Stareye," further boosting its magical energy.

This dagger's hilt is adorned with an eye-catching monster design. It has been made partly using materials taken from actual monsters. A purifying ore and inhibitory magical energy have been used to control their power and channel it into the weapon. The weapon is strong against magical attacks, making it very useful in combat against magic-using monsters. The weapon's hilt itself is purely decorative, and was made at the whim of its forger.

A dagger forged using techniques that originate from an ancient land. Its long, fine blade belies an incredible keenness, and the overwhelming power it gave its users resulted in them being feared as "war gods" across this ancient land. However, the weapon's true value lies in its ability to inflict status ailments when attacking, throwing opponents off their stride. The weapon is imbued with a type of cursed magical energy that increases the user's status infliction rate.

A dagger forged using a mysterious, glowing ore, which was excavated from the ruins of the ancient kingdom that once ruled over the mainland. This ore is able to change shape in reaction to magical energy, and when processed makes a metal that is incredibly light and conducts magical energy extremely well. When slicing into foes, this metal reacts to the magical energy inside their bodies, subtly changing shape in order to reach their vital organs. It therefore boasts a high critical hit rate.

A kitchen knife. Although clearly intended for food preparation, it was forged using techniques that originate from an ancient land, and because of its incredible sharpness has been repurposed as a weapon. Its blade boasts a far keener edge than any regular weapon.

This dagger synchronizes itself with its user, altering its properties accordingly. Fitted with a special spritnite stone and forged from a metal with high magical energy conductivity, this unique weapon detects the physical characteristics of its bearer and increases damage accordingly. It is also strong against both physical and magical attacks, making it excellent for use in any situation.

A knife that was once used as an object of worship by an ancient cult. Its blade is made from a strong metal, but is otherwise not particularly remarkable. Its hilt, however, is made of a jet-black metal that is extracted from an extremely rare and little-known ore. The magical energy imbued in the knife by its many users allows it to draw out latent power from within the bearer, granting incredible powers of concentration, and increasing the speed at which the SP gauge fills up.

A long, simple broadsword. It was given to the owner by Freyja, the leader of the resistance, when accompanying a previous sacrifice on her pilgrimage, and provides considerable power when swung with sufficient speed and force. Its simple design makes it easy to use, and it can deliver powerful blows that pulverize opponents with ease. It was forged using an ore with evil-warding properties, and provides reliable defense against both physical and magical attacks.

A ceremonial blade used in ancient times. Adorned with ancient spritnite stones, its appearance is somewhat sinister. Old texts from the time indicate that this sword itself was in fact an object of worship. Its shining black blade was made using an ore only found in the old rock beds near the coast, which is very difficult to obtain today, undoubtedly making it a highly valuable weapon.

A broadsword with a monolith-like appearance. Its blade looks like it has been carved straight from the earth, and this is in fact exactly the case. It was carved from a huge chunk of ore that is found only near Nive Village. Magical energy was then channeled into it, condensing the earth's power and sealing it inside the blade. It provides excellent magic defense power, and also boosts the bearer's maximum MP.

A mighty broadsword with a boulder-like appearance. Forged using techniques that originate from an ancient land, and an ore mined from lava, the weapon's crude appearance belies a fearsome keenness.
This huge sword stands almost as tall as a man, and is extremely heavy. It delivers incredible damage, boosted by its bearer's strength and the blade's own weight. There is nothing this one-edged sword cannot cut through in a single stroke.

This broadsword has been forged entirely from an ultra-hard and lightweight metal known as Levissium. Levissium is hard to process using current technology, but the closer it is to its original state, the easier it is to process. This weapon capitalizes on this fact, and has been made from a single giant chunk of ore. Despite its huge size, it is incredibly light and easy to wield, allowing its bearer to move swiftly, easily evading enemy attacks. As its blade is also very thick, it can easily deflect physical attacks, reducing their damage.

This bone blade emits a faint white glow. It was created from the bone of some unknown monster, presumably one of incredible size. The weapon appears to have been created long ago, and its blade is heavily nicked. However, this in fact gives it a razor-like quality, increasing the damage it inflicts upon foes. It also has the mysterious effect of filling its wielder with overflowing vitality, boosting HP.

An unusual sword with a saw-like blade. It was created by an organization that once carried out research into magical energy. This organization carried out wide-ranging research, developing not only weapons with raw power, but also ones with revival and recovery effects, body-enhancing effects, and so forth.
This weapon is one such example, and possesses a unique ability to boost the effects of items used.

An ultra-heavy broadsword with a brown-hued blade. According to ancient texts, it was given to a person charged with guarding a key fortress. Bulky and heavy, it is not a weapon that can be wielded by just anyone, and one might even say that this venerable blade chooses its owner. It is said that its former owner protected the fortress's gates to his dying breath, as steadfast as a mountain peak. As its name suggests, the sword provides powerful physical and magical defense.

A broadsword made using materials that were excavated from the ruins of the ancient kingdom that once ruled over the mainland. Due to bad affinity with modern ores, it was created entirely from parts excavated from these same ruins. It seems these parts possessed some powerful defensive power, and the weapon is particularly strong against physical attacks. However, its true value lies in its ability to raise the wielder's SP gauge according to the amount of damage endured.

A giant sword with a simple design. Its forger has done away with all ornamentation, focusing purely on power. An ultra-hard ore has been used in the edge of its blade, while an ultra-light one has been used in the blade's center, ensuring that it is sufficiently lightweight while still retaining the attack power essential for a broadsword. The sword has also been set with a special spritnite stone that absorbs some HP from foes when attacking.

A broadsword received from Freyja in order to aid the current sacrifice on her pilgrimage. For many years it was her weapon of choice, and it is imbued with her spirit. Although it may seem little more than a standard broadsword, upon close inspection its blade is made up of multiple layers, indicating that it has been forged from a variety of metals, and its blade is coated in a thin film of magical energy. It is most definitely a first-class weapon, in terms of both physical and magical attack power.

A mysterious broadsword that was created in another dimension. To all intents and purposes it appears to be a thick wooden branch, so it is uncertain whether the term "broadsword" is really apt. There is nothing uncertain, though, about its incredible strength and attack power, and it is able to easily crush any opponent. Due to its enormous weight, when striking enemies near their vital organs it will inflict more damage than usual. However, there are not many who can wield a weapon of such immense weight...

A broadsword made from the huge bone of some unknown monster. Its guard uses a material similar to the hair of a Dinotaurus, but judging by the size of the bone used in its blade, it likely came from an even larger creature. The blade seems to have been sliced from a very thick, curved bone. Its hooked shape further increases its deadliness, and it is thought to have been made for hunting monsters, but it is unknown who created it, or when. The bone used in its blade causes the wielder to attract the attention of monsters.

A thin, baton-like rod. Despite its appearance, it is a full-fledged rod, and possesses powerful magical energy. A popular choice among novice magic users, its simple structure means it can channel its user's power directly. However, it is ill-suited to guarding against physical attacks, and its user must make sure to keep at a distance from foes during combat.

A white rod in the shape of a pair of scales. Often carried by intermediate magic users, it is able to boost magical energy by focusing it at the top of the rod, releasing attacks more powerful than a regular rod or staff will allow. It is also sturdily made, and offers some degree of protection against both physical and magical attacks.

A beautiful, ornate staff. As most magic users tend to lack strength and stamina, combat with monsters can often take a great toll on them physically. This staff was created by a particularly frail mage who was looked down upon by those around him. In order to overcome his own weakness, he integrated a spritnite stone with powerful stamina-boosting properties into the staff, and also crafted it in such a way that it would reduce damage from physical attacks.

A crescent-moon-shaped staff. It was made by a master craftsman, using a meteorite shard that possessed immense magical energy. The effect of the shard boosts the wielder's magical energy, allowing the use of a wider range of spells than usual. It can also swiftly sense magical attacks from enemies, greatly increasing the user's magical defense power.

A staff made from a branch of the "World Tree," which is said to exist somewhere on the mainland, and possesses colossal amounts of magical energy. This single branch alone contains an immense amount of energy, and even if snapped, this energy will cause it to regain its shape. As even touching the World Tree is strictly forbidden, this staff's origin is uncertain. It was likely taken from the tree by someone long ago, or fell off of its own accord. It grants an immense magical energy to its user.

A beautiful, ornate rod. Most magic users are put at a severe disadvantage if their enemies get too close to them, but this rod eliminates that problem. The blue spritnite stone at its tip reacts automatically when the bearer is attacked, deploying a defensive wall that guards against both physical and magical attacks, greatly mitigating their damage. However, its attack power is somewhat low.

A curved, snakelike rod, set with a red spritnite stone at its tip. This powerful stone is known as the "Witcheye," and grants high magical attack power to the bearer. It also possesses an energy-draining ability, and absorbs some HP from foes when attacking.
Its sinister, energy-stealing nature means that it is generally favored by mages who specialize in the dark arts.

A staff with a pure white wing at its tip. The purpose of this wing is to extract the power of the special spritnite stone set in the staff to its maximum potential. As all mages specialize in magic of a single element, they can often meet their doom when facing powerful monsters that are strong against that element. However, this rod can alter the user's magic so that it ignores elemental strengths and weaknesses, inflicting damage to such monsters regardless.

A staff created from ancient relics excavated from the ruins of the ancient kingdom that once ruled over the mainland. When analyzed, these relics were found to contain vast magical energy. Due to bad affinity with modern ores, it was created entirely from parts excavated from these same ruins. The vast magical energy contained in this staff stimulates the user's own energy, increasing the rate at which the ATB gauge fills up.

A wooden rod with a mallet-like appearance. Although it may look like a mallet, it is indeed a rod, and the head at its tip acts as a catalyst for magic. It appears to be made of wood, but is incredibly sturdy, so much so that if knocked against a rock, the rock will crack rather than the rod splintering. It can be used to smash foes, and its physical attack power makes it very formidable and effective. Its strength also changes vastly depending on the point struck, and it can inflict huge damage when hitting near vital organs.

A rod made from a monster shell that was once used in sacrificial rites. Its design is reminiscent of a stick that a child has used to pick something up, but the tough shell at its tip actually contains great magical energy. This shell is able to focus energy in its spiral before releasing it. The lower the user's HP becomes, the more magical energy is released from the shell, boosting attack power. A humorous design, but in fact a very practical one.

A lance that has been passed down in the royal family for generations. The lance is a weapon that symbolizes the royal family, and historically all heirs to the throne have been handed a simple lance with which they must slay a monster that inhabits a precipitous valley. By piercing this monster's heart, they are seen to have passed their trial, but they are also obligated to carry that same lance for the remainder of their lifetime, like a trusty aide.

A lance with a large protective plate attached to the handle. As lance users primarily make use of their weapon's long reach in order to seize openings in an opponent's defense, a good combination of attack and defense ability is essential. This lance was designed to be able to deflect enemy attacks, warding off both physical and magical attacks in order to regain the offensive. When tempered, the weapon will display an even greater defense power.

An ice lance that emits a frosty aura. Originally a lance with a keen metal blade, the innumerable ice-elemental foes it has slain have imbued it with magical energy of that element. In order to capitalize on this power, a crystal blade made of frozen magical energy has been added to its tip. With its already sharp blade, further sharpened by the addition of this icy blade, it now boasts a truly fearsome attack power.

A mighty lance reminiscent of a fortress. Although its appearance might suggest a weapon best suited to physical attacks, it possesses a magical-energy-boosting ability rooted in astrology. The wielder's magical energy is channeled through the lance and stored in its tip, which has been crafted from a meteorite. Releasing this magical energy makes it possible for the wielder to perform more powerful magic attacks. It also offers strong resistance against magical attacks from enemies.

A silver, spiral-shaped lance. It was used by the princess of an ancient kingdom now long perished. After seeing even her glorious kingdom reduced to ashes in a single night due to war, she created this lance, swearing solemnly that she would forever remain true to herself, both in life and in death. Its spiral signifies "the beginning and the end," and at the same time "eternity." Its spiral tip strikes its foe's weak points with the utmost precision, inflicting mortal wounds.

A lance created from a monster horn said to be the strongest material in existence. Back in the days when knowledge of magical energy was not as advanced as it is now, humans would often create weapons using parts of the bodies of monsters. Although the horn's energy is difficult to control by itself, it has good affinity with other materials from the bodies of monsters, and so this weapon has been made almost entirely from such materials. It boasts extraordinary physical attack power.

Two sibling spirits are said to reside inside this lance. From its ornate inlays, it is clear that it is a holy weapon. The blade at its tip is in fact a detachable shortsword, and it is this blade that has a particularly sacred air about it. Apparently it was once used separately in rituals. Blue is a holy color, and its untarnished hue gives it an even more majestic appearance. Due to the many years of prayers being cast upon it, the weapon has become imbued with a sacred power, and lowers foes' defense power when attacking.

A lance that shines with a dull golden hue. It was originally the lance of the leader of the people who first traveled to the mainland and created the basis for its civilization. These people were highly adept at the use of lances - especially their leader. According to ancient texts, this lance is sentient, and moves exactly as the wielder wishes, granting attack speed that defies the limits of the human body. It is made from an unknown metal that does not exist in this land, and boosts the speed at which the ATB gauge fills up.

The scythe carried by <NAME=CP_0007>. Born from eternal darkness together with him, this weapon has been formed from bitterly-built-up rage and sorrow. It craves only destruction, and boasts an awesome attack power. Its pure hatred towards those who live bright lives of hope and happiness causes it to inflict instant death with a single blow. This weapon truly is the physical embodiment of its creator's rage...

A sinister scythe modeled after the skull of a beast. Its blade glows with an ominous purple hue. It has been soaked in a myriad of poisons and blood, melted down, and then reforged, over and over again. Covered in poisons and blood-rust, it is so toxic that normal people would never be able to wield it. Those it touches have a higher chance of being afflicted with status ailments.

An old scythe discovered in an ancient ruin. Fashioned after the wing of a legendary creature known as a dragon, this elaborately sculpted item was originally for decorative purposes, but it also makes a fine weapon. It has been forged from a very hard ore, perhaps one local to the region where it was created, and is also imbued with abundant magical energy. It therefore reduces damage from both physical and magical attacks.

A jagged-edged scythe that glows with a golden hue. It was crafted using an ore that was altered very little from the condition in which it was found, and the metal used cannot be processed using current techniques. It is unclear whether its shape is intentional or natural. Although the precise identity of the metal used is unknown, when further tempered, it can inflict brutal physical damage.

A scythe that glows with a dull silver hue. It appears to have once been used by a temple knight, but its silver blade has long since lost its radiance, and any holy power has been lost. However, the magical energy inside it still runs strong, and the spritnite stone set in the cross part at the top of its handle serves to further boost this energy. This means that the weapon boasts a fearsome magical attack power.

This scythe emanates an aura of overwhelming malice and hatred. It was once owned by a dark mage known as the "fiendlord," and is even lighter and easier to wield than its orthodox appearance suggests. Its sharpened blade is stained with the blood of all those it has slain, but continues to emit a dull glow. Legend has it that the weapon demonstrates its true power only when all its wielder's companions are in grave danger, and it craves arduous battle, boosting the amount of damage inflicted.

A scythe that was excavated from the ruins of an ancient civilization. It cannot be analyzed using today's technology, and the details of how it was made are unknown. According to ancient texts, the red part of its blade feeds on the blood and magical energy of its victims. This red part is in fact a liquid organism with no fixed shape, but the upper part of the blade fixes it in place, allowing it to be used as a weapon. However, the blade is able to extend when attacking, and it offers a particularly wide attack range.
